title: Biomes O' Cataclysms
description: This mod transforms Vanilla Minecraft into a challenge! One by one, all biomes will be destroyed, so try to complete the game before the end of the world!
body:
# Biomes O' Cataclysms

The world of Minecraft is running out of time. Biomes are being consumed one by one: race against the clock, defeat the Dragon, and survive the end of the world!!

Visit the wiki link to learn more about the mod functions!

Please, if you find any bugs or errors in the game (including mapped errors, strange lag events, or game crashes), use the “issue report" page link. Any detailed report is extremely appreciated, as this mod affects delicate game structures.
